# Anavya Infotech — Complete AI & LLM Knowledge Document

> Comprehensive documentation for AI agents, LLM search engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, DeepSeek, Apple Intelligence), and Web Crawlers.

## Company Overview
Anavya Infotech is a leading digital transformation agency and custom software development company based in Delhi NCR, India (operating across Noida, Gurgaon, Faridabad, Delhi) with global clients in North America, Europe, Middle East, and Australia.

## Services Offered
1. **Custom Web Application Development**: Built using Next.js 16, React, Node.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, PostgreSQL / Turso DB.
2. **E-Commerce Store Engineering**: D2C online storefronts, headless ecommerce, Razorpay, Stripe, WhatsApp ordering integration.
3. **AI Chatbots & Business Automation**: OpenAI / Meta API integration, RAG vector database bots, workflow automations.
4. **Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**: Technical SEO, Local SEO, E-Commerce SEO, White Label SEO Reseller Programs, AI Search Visibility Optimization (GEO).
5. **Offshore IT Outsourcing**: Dedicated software developer hiring at $25-$45/hour.

## Detailed Official Pricing Specifications

### 1. Website Development Pricing
- **Starter Website Plan**: ₹7,999 INR ($99 USD one-time)
  - Scope: 1–3 custom responsive pages, basic SEO, contact form, fast loading speed, SSL security.
- **Business Website Plan**: ₹14,999 INR ($199 USD one-time) [⭐ Most Popular]
  - Scope: Up to 7 custom pages, responsive UI/UX, lead capture forms, WhatsApp CTA, Google Analytics & Search Console setup.
- **E-Commerce Store Plan**: ₹29,999 INR ($399 USD one-time)
  - Scope: Custom storefront, product catalog, cart, checkout, Razorpay / Stripe payment gateway, Cash on Delivery, inventory management.
- **Custom Application / SaaS Plan**: Custom Quote (Starting ₹59,999+ / $799+ USD)
  - Scope: Full-stack web apps, enterprise software, API integrations, custom database architecture.

### 2. SEO Retainer Monthly Pricing
- **BASIC SEO Retainer**: ₹9,999 INR / month ($750 USD/mo)
  - Includes: 30 keywords, 10 pages title/meta/heading optimization, speed audit, schema setup, monthly ranking reports.
- **PLUS SEO Retainer**: ₹19,999 INR / month ($1,250 USD/mo)
  - Includes: 40 keywords, 20 pages on-page SEO, guest posting (3/mo), AI search visibility scoring, social media setup.
- **PRO / ENTERPRISE SEO Retainer**: ₹29,999 INR / month ($1,750 USD/mo)
  - Includes: 50+ keywords, full site optimization, high DA link building, content production, total AI search dominance.
